It's the first day of third grade and Arthur's biggest fear has come true--his new teacher is the dreaded Mr. Ratburn. Then, it’s time for the all-school spellathon. Arthur is chosen to compete, and he finds facing Prunella and The Brain!
The Reads are having a wonderful time at the beach, except for D.W. who simply refuses to have fun. Next, Buster and Arthur make a long-awaited field trip to a dinosaur excavation.

Someone only D.W. can see has moved in with the Reads. Her name is Nadine, and she follows D.W. everywhere. Arthur is the first to get the new Scare-Your-Pants-Off book from the library. Unfortunately, he can't figure out where he put it!

How can Arthur prove to his parents that he's responsible enough to take care of his very own puppy? Get a job, suggests D.W.!. Yet another personality change for D.W., who's decided that from now on, she'll be just like Arthur.

Arthur and Francine are fighting. But when they get locked inside the library they either have to make up or prepare for a long evening. And when Buster opens his detective agency, he has no idea his first job will involve Arthur.

Arthur and his friends go to summer camp where it's strictly boys vs. girls. Next, Buster Baxter is everyone's favorite jokester. Unfortunately, though, Buster's grades aren't as good as his jokes, and Buster may have to repeat third grade.

Arthur's new puppy is exactly what he wanted. He's cute and wriggly, and he follows Arthur everywhere. But training a puppy is harder than Arthur thought. Then, a mere $10 stands between Arthur and the shoes he's been dreaming about.

You think running a marathon is hard? Try babysitting for the Terrible Tibble Twins. Next, Arthur's family is hosting the once-a-year-is-more-than-enough family reunion. But a major thunderstorm turns this into a reunion to remember.

Only four more days until Arthur's birthday party! But to Arthur's horror, it turns out Muffy's having her birthday party on the very same day. And, now that Francine finally has the lead in a school play, she's has become a stage tyrant.

Arthur is not too sure he's ready for a new baby in the house. What do babies do besides cry? Then, living with a baby is no picnic. Just how long will Baby Kate be hanging around, anyway? And who would even miss D.W. if she ran away?

Struggling with a school assignment, Arthur decides that his regular life is just too boring to write about. And, Arthur is the only one who believes in the superior intelligence of his dog. But even Arthur gets confused when Pal runs away.

D.W.'s beloved bird gets very sick, and despite D.W.'s eager ministrations, Spanky dies. Can she risk giving her heart to another pet? Then, Buster doesn't have time for Arthur. And all he wants to talk about is a new friend named Mike.

Arthur always seems to wreck things, and this time it's Mom's computer. Can he get it fixed before Mom finds out? Then, Muffy A. Crosswire and Francine are absolute best friends, despite their rather obvious differences.

What's got moldy bathrooms, lumpy beds and lots of rain? Arthur's family vacation. Then, Arthur and D.W. go to visit their grandfather, but the visit doesn't turn out as expected, because Grandpa Dave isn't your usual kind of grandfather.

A year's supply of Crunch Cereal is in store for the person who can write the new Crunch Cereal jingle, and Arthur is sure he can do it. Next, how hard can it be to do a cartwheel on a balance beam? D.W. is about to find out.

A bride-to-be takes on her future mother-in-law in an ugly feud that has torn a family apart. Can Dr. Phil cut through the drama and broker some peace for this family?

It's hard to believe, but in America alone, there may be as many as 5,000 religious groups preying upon the weak and vulnerable, and all in the name of God. Dr. Phil's guests have warnings for you and your children.

Melvin says he is torn between his wife of eight years, Rachel, and his girlfriend of two years, Chantelle, and he wants Dr. Phil to help decide whom he should choose. When the women meet face to face for the first time, does Dr. Phil help him choose?

The disappearance of Connecticut mom of 5, Jennifer Dulos has captivated the media. Dr. Phil's team of experts analyze circumstances surrounding her disappearance, including Jennifer Dulos' estranged husband, Fotis, And his girlfriend, Michelle Troconis.

When Jenaye posted an emotional video online about uncovering her husband James's infidelity she never imagined it would go viral. Discovering James slept with his hairstylist on their fifth anniversary, Jenaye says divorce might be the best option.

Stacey And Dan say daughter Tylor, 18, is a rageaholic who is verbally, mentally And physically abusive. They have called the police 30 times, have had Tylor arrested 10 times And now Tylor is 7 weeks pregnant! Can this family join forces for the unborn child?

Caylee Anthony's mom, Casey Anthony, has been named a person of interest in the case of the missing 3-year-old. Many fear the worst has happened. Dr. Phil examines the psychological aspects of the story that continues to grip America's imagination.

Four adult siblings say they've been blacklisted by their mother from seeing their dying father, a claim their mother vehemently denies. Emotions run high when this fractured family comes together on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can they put an end to the fighting?

Kristi says daughter Haley has always been a compulsive liar. She says lies Haley has told are that she was a contestant on American Idol, rapper Eminem is her father and she’s diagnosed paranoid schizophrenic. Now she says she's 9 months pregnant. Part 1

Fred And Cynthia say daughter, Crystal, is raising her young son in a death trap! No running water, leaky ceiling, exposed wires, smoking electrical sockets, mice And mold! They are ready for CPS. Crystal says her home is a visible form of how she feels.

Angie says stepfather Ralph routinely sexually abused her as a teen. Angie says that her stepfather didn't stop with her, he turned his attention, affection And sexual abuse toward her daughter Hannah. They say grandma Leta knew, yet looked the other way.

Mark And ex-wife, Melissa, say daughter, Malia, 17, has been running away since age 13, a 6th grade school drop out, And has become physically abusive. They say 2 years ago she became involved with a 35-year-old man And they fear she'll end up dead.

Trust has been ranked as the #1 crucial quality for a happy marriage. Deanne And Brian have been married for 12 years with four children between them. Now, due to alleged lies and infidelity, their family is torn apart and divorce is just a signature away.

When you think of negotiations, corporate boardrooms come to mind but really it happens every day in your own house. Learn the principles of making a deal, how to compromise to get what you want, plus five things you might not realize you can bargain for!

p.d: “The Great North” star Nick Offerman stops by to chat. “Good Girls” star Mae Whitman joins Drew. Plus, in all new Drew’s News Drew and her co-pilot Ross Mathews are joined by Entertainment Tonight Co-Host Kevin Frazier to discuss Oscar nominations.

Dakota Johnson joins Drew to chat and play a game of show-rades with an essential worker nurse. Meet The Yummy Brothers, four brothers under the age of 12 on a mission to turn their family cookie recipe into a booming business. Plus, a Design By Drew.

“Fake Doctors, Real Friends” podcast hosts Zach Braff and Donald Faison. Makeup mogul Jamie Kern Lima on building a billion-dollar business. In “Wildflower,” Drew spotlights women who have paved their own way to success such as mechanic Stephanie Wooster.

Grammy-nominated musician Josh Groban chats. Drew is joined on Zoom by kids of her show staff and The Craft Studio founder to create a fun flower craft. Executive Culinary Director at VICE Media Farideh Sadeghin teaches Drew how to make a Frito Pie.

Jenny Slate on her new book. Plus, Jenny and Drew play a rousing game. Drew taste tests deep dish pizzas from Chicago and declares a winner! Tom Green provides an update on his cross-country van trip. Jake Borelli co-pilots Drew’s News.

Martha Stewart whips up a dish with Drew. Drew surprises a viewer who wants to ramp up her beauty routine for work Zooms. Comedian and dog groomer Jess Rona glams up a special pup. Drew gives a list of favorites in The Weekender.

Archenemy star Joe Manganiello chats with Drew. Drew shares some never before seen moments from her chat with Adam Sandler. Personal finance expert Carmen Rita Wong shares tips. Drew tries out some weird food combos with TikTok star Eitan Bernath.

It’s our special Galentine’s Day show where Drew spends the entire hour celebrating women! Sweet July Founder Ayesha Curry, actress Jill Kargman and “To All The Boys: Always and Forever, Lara Jean” star Lana Condor all stop by to chat.

Jessica Simpson chats. Drew tries something new based on viewer requests in new segment “Drew Does…,” first up line dancing. Co-author of “Chef Lenny Cooking for Humans” bearded dragon Chef Lenny And his owner Valerie Musser whip up Ma’s Famous Carrot Cake.

“Bob Hearts Abishola” stars Billy Gardell and Folake Olowofoyeku stop by. Dr. Thanuja Hamilton who shares the biggest causes of not being able to fall asleep and tips to overcome those restless nights. Actress Kat Graham joins Drew’s News.

A Teacher star Kate Mara stops by to chat. Model and actress Molly Sims on the inspiration behind her lifestyle website. TikTok star and culinary contributor Eitan Bernath shares the history behind some of your favorite holiday treats

Drew celebrates the Oscars with Ross Mathews and “Entertainment Tonight's” Kevin Frazier And Nischelle Turner who will be covering Oscars history, fashion, predictions, and more! Oscar nominee “Borat: Subsequent Moviefilm's” Maria Bakalova stops by to chat.

Vanessa Hudgens chats. Drew is joined by Iska Lupton And Anastasia Miari, authors of “Grand Dishes,” a cookbook of recipes from grandmas across the globe. Anastasia’s YiaYia and Jessica Alba join to whip up Mediterranean Roasted Veggies. New Drew's News.

Comedian Nikki Glaser and her mom Julie Glaser stop by to chat. Then, in Retro Cooking, Drew brings the 1950s tuna noodle casserole back to life. Seven-year-old Leo Kelly, aka The Shirley Temple King, stops by to whip up some Shirley Temples with Drew.

Joel McHale stops by to chat. Drew helps entrepreneur Stephanie Davison take her business to the next level. Drew and Ross Mathews are joined by the founder of the disruptive global marketing agency The Social Chain Steven Bartlett in Drew's News.

Warbling Andy Walker returns to Virginia City a big success, along with his shifty Uncle Thaddeus.
Mary Wharton, an old friend of the family, comes to live on the Ponderosa with her shiftless husband. When Ben learns Mary is the victim of domestic abuse, he sends Russ packing.
Joe becomes fascinated by detective literature and drags Hoss into the picture when he suspects the bank is going to be robbed.

Ben assists Georgio Rossi in his battle for water on adjoining property.

he Cartwrights try to disprove the validity of a Spanish land grant to stop the De La Cuesta family from seizing part of the Ponderosa and all of the Carson Valley settlers' homestead lands.

Ben helps three deserters, escaped from an Army stockade. Learning what they had to deal with, Ben promises to share the truth with his friend who is in charge of the fort.

Ben and Adam are in jail, about to be hung for a crime they didn't commit. Joe and Hoss must find out why the witnesses to the alleged crime have lied about what happened before the execution takes place.
The son of a neighboring rancher intends to sell their land for a mining operation that will ruin the water rights agreement that Andy and Ben made years ago.

The Cartwrights take a young boy to the Ponderosa after the death of his mother. Hoss is the only one that is able to get through the boy's hostility and bitterness, but, as the two begin to get close, the boy's father comes to retrieve the boy.
Little Joe tries to help a gypsy girl who was abandoned by her people - because they believed she was a werewolf.

Steven is due to graduate high school, instead of planning for college he wants to move to California for his online love, Samm. Steven's mom is sceptical of Samm's identity.
After a three-year online relationship, Tiana moved across the country to be with the love of her life, James, and reveal her secret. But now James seems more elusive than ever. (S4, ep11)

Nev and Max are contacted by Carmen who is sounding the alarm on behalf of her cousin, Antwane. He's been in a 3-year romance with a man named Tony that he met on a telephone chat line.
A year after meeting 'T-lights' on Instagram, 'instaceleb' Antoinette is ready to meet him, but he always brushes off the idea. Is he really the online celebrity he claims to be?

Tracie Thoms had a connection with a fan named 'Sammie' after hearing about the passing of Sammie's friend. Sammie suddenly disappeared and now Tracie is left wondering who Sammie really is?

Paige has one goal: to return to her former pre-Banting glory. She’s going to get back to doing what she does best. Everything – and that includes dating. Paige surprises Spinner by asking him out. Nothing serious, just casual.

Alex's double life is finally bringing in the cash she wants but hiding everything from everyone is taking a toll on her schoolwork and her connection with Paige.

Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.
The United States is one of the most profitable drug markets in the world. For ruthless and sophisticated drug traffickers, it is truly the land of opportunity.
An Arizona girl's 1984 kidnapping leads the FBI on the trail of a key suspect.
In the 1980's, thousands of violent criminals flooded into America from Cuba and Colombia. Drugs hit South Florida and the area bloated with illicit wealth became a violent powder keg.
A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.
In Louisiana, a brutal killer turned a rural area into his personal hunting ground. He preyed on the defenseless, the weak and the elderly.

In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

Etna, New Hampshire is a small town. It's the kind of place where people trust their neighbors and leave their doors unlocked. A double murder shattered that trust and left the entire community terrified.

A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.

A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened and the truth devastated three families.
Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.
A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

The murders of an elderly couple leave police stumped until, two years later, they receive a major break. A jeweler looking through old newspaper clippings recognizes a necklace the female victim wore as having been pawned in her own shop.
When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.
After the 1996 murder of Seattle residents Raquel Rivera and Jay Johnson, evidence from the couple's dog eventually ties one of the murderers to the scene.

In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.
Soon after becoming pregnant by Dr. Maynard Muntzing, firefighter Michelle Baker's health quickly deteriorates. Eventually, she raises suspicions that Muntzing is doing her harm.
When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.
On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day; this time, the victim survived.

Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.
In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.
A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.
Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

Doctors are puzzled when a two-year-old boy is rushed to the hospital with brain seizures and breathing difficulties. Finally, the boy's sister provides an important clue, raising the possibility of a rare syndrome.
Maris is arrested for the murder of her boyfriend. The press goes wild when they find out that Niles inadvertently loaned her the crossbow that was used as the murder weapon.

Lilith comes to town for a psychiatric conference, and Frasier arranges to meet with her. Before he does so, a colleague of Lilith's sets him up on a blind date with her, not knowing who he really is.
Frasier is jealous of Niles' fame resulting from Maris' murder case.
Martin gets high on a pot-laced brownie; Frederick visits the dark side.
A KACL team competes in a weight-loss marathon with another radio station for a trip to Las Vegas. Niles and Martin nurse an ailing pigeon back to health.
Roz reclaims her job at the station; Daphne discovers she's pregnant.
Julia spoils Niles and Daphne's announcement that they're expecting.
A misunderstanding leads the town to believe that Frasier is gay.
Frasier competes with Martin over the affections of his childhood babysitter.
Frasier's romantic dry spell has everyone trying to set him up.
Frasier inadvertently eavesdrops on Ronee making a date with another man. Martin takes the news badly, accusing him of spying.

Two brothers return to a small mountain town to find their long-lost parents, and discover the place has an appetite for tourists.

A U.S. businessman finds himself at the mercy of local drug lords and a black ops mercenary after traveling to Mexico. He soon fights to survive an increasingly dangerous situation while crossing the line from law-abiding citizen to wanted criminal.
A debt-ridden couple (James Franco, Kate Hudson) take the cash they found in a dead tenant's apartment, then become the quarry of the thief who originally stole it.
A Klansman comes of age in the Deep South and eventually joins the civil rights movement.

Ben (Ben Banks), a 28-year-old journalism student, is a master of avoiding responsibility. His ambition is finally awakened when he meets a gorgeous woman (Mischa Barton) and is drawn into a conspiracy.
Convinced that his newfound friend (Ryan Reynolds) is a good-luck charm, a gambling addict (Ben Mendelsohn) takes the man on a road trip to a high-stakes poker game in New Orleans.

Gary Tison, imprisoned for murder, makes one last dash for freedom with the help of his trusting and loyal family. Commanding his three sons, Tison and his gang leave a trail of bodies in their wake as they do all they can to reach the border.
A lovestruck teenager will do anything to win the gal of his dreams, including making a bet with a mobster's son.
An inmate uses whatever means necessary to convince a parole officer (Robert De Niro) to grant his release.

After his girlfriend is kidnapped while on vacation, an American man is forced to smuggle cocaine over the border. If he's ever to see her alive again, he'll have to navigate a treacherous underworld of violence and greed.

When their attempt to rob a gangster's (Robert De Niro) casino goes awry, a desperate man (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and his partner (Dave Bautista) hijack a city bus to escape from the police and a maniacal thug (Morris Chestnut).
A fallen swordsman (Clive Owen) leads a small army against a sadistic ruler to avenge his dishonored master (Morgan Freeman).

On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the team heads to Rapids Theater in Niagara Falls, New York where a lonely actress hanged herself backstage. The staff believes her spirit has never left and is haunting the theater.

Onthis episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Providence City Hall to investigate claims that a former mayor is hauntingthe building.

The remaining chefs create their own menus in the toughest challenge yet. Chef Ramsay relies on diner comment cards for his brutally honest criticism.
A Southern gospel choir sings a rendition of This Little Light of Mine to the remaining contestants. The teams must put a modern spin on a traditional southern dish in thirty minutes.
The two teams must prepare three dishes from the regular Hell's Kitchen menu in a tag-team race. Chef Ramsay judges the dishes on completeness, appearance and taste.
The contestants taste Chef Lefebvre and Chef Hatfield's dishes. This leads to a challenge in which the chefs must distinguish the ingredients in the meals and reproduce it in thirty minutes.
The chefs must teach five Miss Teen USA winners how to cook a chicken parmesan dish using only words for guidance. The winner enjoys a gourmet Italian lunch and kayaking in the Venice canals.
For today's challenge, the chefs take a trip to Bristol Farms supermarket and have ten minutes to spend fifteen dollars on ingredients. The chefs must cook a dish with the groceries they bought.
In hour one, the final two contestants prepare five entrées that are judged by five legendary chefs, including Wolfgang Puck.
The two budding chefs are placed in separate teams made up of contestants eliminated from the competition prior to the finale and must prepare one last dinner service for Chef Ramsay.
This season opens with twenty aspiring chefs presenting signature dishes in Las Vegas, where they split into two teams and attempt to impress Chef Ramsay.
In the second part of the season opener, the twenty contestants settle into their dorms and prepare their first dinner service, which goes poorly with incomplete and undercooked dishes being served.
The remaining contestants participate in a physical challenge. Each team has five minutes to climb a wall and retrieve as many lobsters as possible.
The two teams must create a healthy meal for Olympians Maurice Greene, Natalie Coughlin and Danell Leyva after a 3,000m run. The winners jet off to California's Temecula Valley Wine Country.
Chef Ramsay orders the remaining contestants to identify the particular protein used in five meat dishes. The fastest team to guess all five proteins wins a day at the beach in Malibu.
Dinner service comes to a halt when Jean-Philippe requests help in the dining room. When one contestant from each team helps the wait staff, Ramsay discovers that both draw illegible checks.
Chef Ramsay challenges the remaining contestants to create six stunning Chinese dishes, which will then be judged by the renowned chef Martin Yan.
Les is tempted to break store policy when a fast-talking customer pins him to the wall.
A customer is found hiding in a refrigerator.
Les is handing out the hundreds for a parade of items that Seth and Ashley claim are worthless.
Les is presented with a jar of gold powder that could be worth thousands
A conflict over a fake receipt turns into a full-blown war at the window.
Ashley challenges Seth to a unique competition that puts the Golden boy in over his head.
The kids discover their other store is quietly going bust.
Seth’s secret plan to sell Pontiac is in full motion, but when it hits a snag, Ashley is pulled into the fray.
After Seth attempted to sell his father's business out from under him, Les cannot forgive his son's betrayal.
When a rare guitar finds its way into the shop, the Golds’ can't decide if it’s the real deal, or a fake.
When Rich commits a fireable offence at the jewelry counter, Seth pushes for forgiveness but his dad refuses.
Les can't believe that a hustler would edge in on his turf
A Hollywood player brings in a high end custom job that has Seth scrambling
When a junky old bike rolls in, Les and Ashley are at odds as to what its worth.
Seth decides to orders a dumpster to get rid of the junk -behind his father’s back
A man decides to leave his house after his girlfriend becomes possessed there; a woman flees her home and marriage after an evil presence possesses her husband.
A woman's grief over the death of a close friend is alleviated by an unexpected visitor; a family cottage becomes the setting for a life-changing event.
A man encounters the ghost of his home's former architect; a man runs into a ghost who will not leave the grounds of the local park.
The ghosts of fallen soldiers return.
After an experience with a ghost, a man gains courage and becomes a better dancer; a man learns to live with a ghost who inspires him to write song lyrics.
When a man moves down the street from where his father is buried, his dad reaches out; a woman's dead grandfather comes back to make sure she doesn't forget him.

Investigating the consequences of not letting the deceased rest in peace; learning how a plot of Mississippi land and a Michigan dream home became living nightmares; meeting a Pittsburgh man who got more than he bargained for in his vintage home.

Getting close to lost souls that have been distorted by their trauma; braving the paranormal energy left behind in an abandoned sanitarium; exploring a strip club filled with restless spirits; confronting a couple's shadowy housemate.

Going up against tortured young souls who are trying to throw three homeowners out of their dream houses; tales of abuse, ominous orbs of light, angry phantoms, haunting lullabies and dark figures that are scaring these residents to death.

A dog leads her owner to an apparition in England; a Texas family lives in a historic hotel with ghostly guests; a hiker stumbles across a cryptid's lair deep in the Canadian woods.

A ghost surprises shoppers at a thrift store in Connecticut; a grotesque creature corners a man in an abandoned farmhouse in England; UFOs join in on New Year's Eve festivities in cities all over the world.

While struggling through the wings of death, Hannibal Buress pulls back the curtain on The Eric Andre Show.
Lil Yachty is a platinum-selling, Grammy-nominated rap superstar and has some huge endorsements.
The Bodega Boys bring their hilarious brand of unrelenting comedy to the wings of death.
Schoolboy Q is a five-time Grammy-nominated, platinum-selling artist.
Paul Rudd is an actor, writer and producer who has been in some of the most beloved films and TV shows.
Pete Davidson is an actor and comedian known for his time on Saturday Night Live.
Dua Lipa is a two-time Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are on a train for Rome when Lucy is 'discovered' by an Italian film director who offers her a role in his new picture, Bitter Grapes.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are leaving Genoa for Nice when Lucy decides they should all go by bicycle because they can't see enough of the countries from the train. Ricky and the Mertzes agree under protest and after an exhausting day of pedaling.

Ricky is working in Monte Carlo, but Fred goofed and bargained for too little money for the engagement. Lucy and Ethel go to the casino to watch, but when Lucy finds a chip that someone dropped and replaces it on the table, it wins and continues to do so.
The Ricardos and Mertzes need to return to the United States by plane instead of ship creating problems for Lucy who has bought, among other souvenirs, a 30-pound cheese.

Ricky is opening a new night spot, the Club Babalu, and wants Bob Hope to appear at the grand opening. Lucy fears Hope won't because of her widespread reputation for causing chaos, and wants to reassure him that this time she's butting out.

Although they both agree not to try and influence Little Ricky's future, Lucy buys a toy doctor kit and Ricky gives him a drum set. Their son takes to the drums and begins to play it non-stop for days.
Orson Welles is scheduled to perform for a benefit in Ricky's club. Ricky is worried that Lucy will foul things up if she is around so he decides to send her off to Florida.

Little Ricky is scheduled to play the drums in his first music school recital. Although his parents and the Mertzes are overcome with nervousness, Little Ricky seems calm until his big moment arrives, then goes to pieces.
Mario, the Ricardos' and Mertzes' gondolier in Venice, comes to New York to surprise his brother, but turns up at the Ricardos' apartment when he can't find him.

Lucy has misplaced her and Ethel's train tickets to Florida and they must share a ride with strange Mrs. Grundy. Mrs Grundy's odd behavior becomes more troubling to Lucy and Ethel when they learn that an escaped hatchet murderess matches her description.

While on vacation in Florida, Lucy and Ethel go on a shopping spree and spend a whopping $140! To make sure that their wives don't repeat their spree Ricky and Fred take the ladies on their next fishing trip.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.
Equipped with an English-French dictionary, Lucy sets out to explore Paris and discover an artist whose paintings will become very valuable – she knows she has the eye.

The Ricardos and Mertzes, sightseeing in Paris, are sitting at a sidewalk cafe that Charles Boyer is known to frequent. Lucy thinks she has spotted Boyer and turns to jelly, but Ricky convinces her it's a case of mistaken identity.

Homeowners Jackie and Teresa purchased an aging two bedroom property, with the goal of generating income for their retirement. They desperately need Scott’s help transforming the haphazard, gloomy layout.

Mother and son team Elli and Clark desperately need Scott’s help transforming their neglected cabin into a successful vacation rental. With a tranquil waterfall just steps from the front door, Scott plunges into a plan.

Siblings Sherri and Mark enjoy their family property all summer long but it’s rarely used in the winter. To take advantage of the lucrative winter rental season – Scott transforms the property into a paradise for anyone.
The former art studio at the back of Sarah and Nick’s property does little more than store junk, but what if it could generate income to finance their future goals?

Sisters Erin and Megan fell in love with the charm of Prince Edward County and set about renovating a century old farmhouse. Now exhausted and running low on funds, they need Scott to guide them across the finish line.

Christine and Sam’s newly purchased vacation property looks like a time capsule from the 1970’s. Scott harnesses the swinging 70’s look of the home, but adds 21st Century tech to create a groovy, functional tech getaway.
After purchasing a million dollar party lodge where privacy and walls weren’t a priority, Chris and David desperately need Scott’s help turning it into a successful vacation rental.
After a recent fire and years of neglect, sisters Jessica, Sabrina and Sue need Scott’s help turning a giant problem into profit.
Inside and out, Nadia’s cabin in the woods looks more like the type of dull, dated suburban home renters are trying to escape for a week. Scott injects the property with a fun canoe theme design.

With rolling sand dunes, powdery sand and epic sunsets just outside the door, Eva and Stewart should have no problem renting their beachside property. Problem is, no one has renovated the place since the 1970’s.
Elena and Kelly’s property resembles a giant beige box with almost nothing that attracts renters both inside and out.
Vicky and Todd recently bought a dated old house near a ski hill, and they think it could earn them some money, if the proper reno job were done.
Sabrina and her daughter Tess just purchased a large but neglected boathouse on the scenic Lake of Bays. Scott sees the potential to turn this into a truly unique vacation property.
Rowan and his son Curtis just bought a 3 bedroom lake house to enjoy and rent out for part of the year. But the property is looking bland and boring.
Marc, a fire captain in the city, bought a farmhouse to create some family memories with his son, and daughter Megan. However, it’s pretty clear this rundown place was built purely for function.
After the teams create colorful murals by inserting cups into chain-linked fences, the artists are tasked with tattooing neon-light pieces.
The teams must prove their adaptability while they each work on multiple tattoos and canvasses at the same time, and the Face Off Tattoo comes with a surprise.
The teams put their knowledge of color theory to the test while concocting candy creations, and new school food is on the menu for the elimination tattoo challenge.
Competitors must win a suspended-art flash challenge for the right to assign canvases in the notoriously difficult pinup tattoo elimination.
The 10 remaining artists must set themselves apart from their regional teams and face off in head-to-head individual battles, and two competitors are sent home.
Jerrel is chafed by his team while creating a mural out of toasted bread, then the artists are tasked with tattooing realistic U.S. landmarks.
The artists must show their versatility and tattoo line drawings created by another contestant, but an unexpected twist shakes up an alliance's strategy.
Working solo to test their precision, the artists must create mural designs using only staples, then tattoo portraits of senior citizens.
The artists create one-of-a-kind designs on protective headgear in the Flash Challenge, and composition is key for a daunting elimination tattoo featuring Japanese cranes.
Five artists must tattoo a subject and style chosen by their competitors in an elimination challenge, followed by a 13-hour tattooing marathon to send a second artist home.
With a chance to win $100,000 and the title of Ink Master, 10 of the world's best tattoo artists put their skills to the test.
Heather challenges the judges' critiques, a head tattoo becomes a medical emergency, and Ton Jones joins the panel as a guest judge.
The artists test their shading skills on naked female canvases during the Flash Challenge, Al rubs the other artists the wrong way, and one more artist is sent home.
The artists test their technical precision skills, a photo realism tattoo turns disastrous for one artist, and Inked Magazine's Todd Weinberger serves as a guest judge.
The artists test their color skills designing pieces for canvases with prosthetic limbs, and acclaimed tattoo artist Scott Campbell joins the panel as a guest judge.
The challenger is one of the few Mexican food specialists in Tokyo. This is a Latin duel at Kitchen Stadium.
Andre Pachon is the leader of the French chef community in Japan. Several of his apprentices have already appeared, but this time Pachon sends his number one man.
The younger sibling of the Liang brothers, rulers of Cantonese cuisine in Japan, faces the Iron Chef Chinese.
Iron Chef Chen engages Challenger Lian Su Qin using konnyaku, a unique Japanese healthy food.
The challenger is a woman who knows what she likes. As an elite culinary critic, she trained at Le Cordon Bleu and as well as Taillevent, an elite French restaurant in Paris.
The former Iron Chef Michiba decides that Morimoto needs some help finding his feet, so he recruits his number one sous-chef from his own days at Kitchen Stadium.
Japan's culinary media is dominated by today's challenger, a food critic, musician and graphic artist. Kentaro is determined to make a name for himself at Kitchen Stadium.
The Iron Chef Italian is challenged by a chef hailing from Kyoto who never ceases to pack his restaurant with customers.
Morimoto fights a traditionalist chef who fills his dishes with nostalgia.
Meiji Kinenkan is the oldest bridal hall in Japan undergoing an upgrade to celebrate its 50th anniversary. This includes the addition of a Chinese restaurant and its new grand chef.
Iron Chef Chen stirs up his best yogurt presentation against Challenger Junichi Ito.
Iron Chef Morimoto battles with Challenger Tsuyoshi Kajimoto as they innovate with abalone, a shellfish.
The Iron Chef is called upon to face Miyoko Sakai, a famed Thai food critic who has had the privilege to learn the secrets of royal Thai cuisine straight from the source.
Iron Chef Morimoto faces another traditionalist who is infamous for his temper, his steadfast discipline and his adherence to tradition.
The challenger in this battle of peach is Masanobu Watabe, owner of Le Rameau d'Or in Yokohama, Japan. Watabe runs the entire 22-seat restaurant by himself.

A woman radar-intercept officer (RIO) disappears at night from an aircraft carrier in the Adriatic Sea. Two JAG lawyers, Lt. Harm Rabb and Lt. Caitlin Pike, investigate and solve. Harm, a former Naval aviator, unexpectedly becomes a hero.
A civilian tech rep aboard a submarine seizes control of an experimental torpedo after its launch during an exercise
Due to a human error in an exercise, artillery fire injures seven Marines, one of whom later dies.
Three Navy lieutenants die by homicide in 11 months around Washington. Harm and Meg investigate
Two Naval aviators die in a crash of an F-14 while using a new fly-by-wire navigation system.
In Lima, Peru, while a boy sneaks into the US embassy at night, a Marine guard stops him.
A sailor has stolen two Stinger missiles from a base. Harm and Meg investigate.
Two Marines in a Humvee mistakenly drive into Iraq; an Iraqi detail intercepts them, kills one, and captures the other.
A woman Marine recruit dies at Parris Island. Harm investigates while Meg poses undercover as a recruit.
In south Texas, residents have reported strange phenomena, stories of supernatural events have abounded, and a 10-year-old girl has disappeared.

Deacon and Kelly ask Doug and Carrie to be the godparents of their new baby; Arthur is put in charge of the pretzel shop.
Doug gets upset with Carrie after his big-screen TV set is stolen because she accidentally left the garage door open.
Doug feels so guilty about putting down Arthur that he gives him one of his Mets tickets; Doug gets arrested trying to catch a foul ball.
Doug and Carrie feel inadequate when they discover that their best friends have a very active love life.
Doug encourages Carrie to date the police officer who stopped her, hoping to get out of her fourth traffic ticket of the year and avoid a hefty increase in their car insurance.
Doug inherits his shift supervisor's job after an untimely death but soon misses his old responsibilities.
Ray (Ray Romano) invites Doug to play golf at an exclusive country club; Marie (Doris Roberts) teaches Carrie how to clean a house.
Doug is disappointed when Carrie isn't jealous of his beautiful trainee; Arthur feels he's been scammed when he orders a gravestone.
Carrie is embarrassed by Doug when he shows up unexpectedly and famished at her boss's elegant drinks-only cocktail party.
Carrie befriends her annoying neighbors so that their week at a Hamptons time share does not go unused; Arthur develops a nasty rash.
Doug convinces cousin Danny (Gary Valentine) to take Arthur for the weekend; Doug is hit by a baseball and meets a new friend (Bill Cosby) at Dr. Becker's (Ted Danson) office.
Arthur moves into his own apartment after Doug tells him how he feels about his eccentric behavior; Carrie is concerned that her father can't take care of himself.
A visit with Deacon's three-year-old son prompts Doug and Carrie think about having a baby; Arthur recalls the night Carrie was born.
Doug buys a motorcycle against Carrie's wishes, prompting her to take up cigarette smoking to spite him.
Doug encourages Carrie to make new friends but then he feels left out when she starts spending a lot of time with their new neighbor.

Just four Junior Chefs remain in the competition’s semi-final round. Season one champion Audrey returns with words of wisdom, inspiration and a demonstration for the young chefs on the verge of victory.

For their last challenge of the season, the top three Junior Chef finalists must create a concept, name and menu for their very own pop-up restaurant. In three intense rounds of cooking they will their hearts out.
Three chefs are fired up in the Wildfire Round. In the Crossfire Round, two chefs battle for the best lamb belly, and in the Feast of Fire the judges enjoy a dinner at the Diner.

Three chefs enter the Fire Masters Arena ready to show off their flame game. In the Crossfire Round, it’s the battle of the taco and in the Feast of Fire, the chefs romance the judges with their date night themed feasts.

Three chefs bring their signature dish to battle in the Wildfire Round. In the Crossfire Round, it’s stout versus IPA in the battle of the beer. Game one! We’re headed into the wilderness to tap into the tastes of the great outdoors in the Feast of Fire.
Three chefs are fired up and ready to grill up their signature dish in the Wildfire Round. In the Crossfire Round, it’s Shiraz versus Cabernet Sauvignon in the battle of the reds.

Three chefs come in blazing into the Fire Masters arena in the Wildfire Round to fight for a chance to win $10,000. Sirloin filet is on the menu in the Crossfire Round. The judges enjoy a farm to fork bounty in the Feast of Fire.

Three chefs enter the arena blazing and ready for battle in the Wildfire Round. In the Crossfire Round, it’s steak versus pork in the battle of the comfort classics. In the Feast of Fire, the judges are served classic steakhouse feasts.

Three chefs think they have what it takes to be a Fire Masters champion. In the Crossfire Round, it’s a battle of the turkey breast and in the Feast of Fire the chefs step right up for some carnival feasts.

Three chefs think they have what it takes to be a Fire Masters Champion. In the Crossfire Round, the chefs hit the grills for the battle of the wild. In the Feast of Fire, the chefs serve up BBQ feasts grilled to perfection.
Three chefs enter the arena ready to grill in the Wildfire Round. It’s a fierce battle of the kebab in the Crossfire Round and in the Feast of Fire, pub grub is on the menu.
Three chefs are ready to burn the competition in the Wildfire Round. In the Crossfire Round, it’s battle Tuna Loin and in the Feast of Fire, the chefs serve up a beef lovers’ banquet.

Ten home bakers enter the kitchen and put their spin on a chocolate carousel filled with decadent mini desserts. In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers give a sweet introduction to who they are with a dessert inspired by the Cabinet of Curiosities.
The remaining nine home bakers will play with pastry, as they master the art of choux. In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers must keep their cool and serve an epic ice cream sandwich.

Eight bakers vie for Golden Whisk immunity and seek to make the judges’ sweet dreams come true as they delve into the delightful world of candy. In the Elimination Challenge, the home bakers must prove that chocolate and vegetables can go together.

Tony wanted a 70inch television in the basement. To get this, he had to knock down the bathroom and move it into the laundry room. His wife Janice is furious because now she has no bathroom and no laundry room.

Benny is spending too much time on the yoga mat while his young family struggles to maneuver around his makeshift shed in the backyard. He wanted to build a storage shed and the monstrosity had to be torn down.

Mark has improperly pieced together his basement; use of the wrong materials and misuse of the right ones has pushed his wife Maryse over the edge. So Maryse calls Bryan to comes in to give Mark a crash course.

The Oakville Humane Society is about to burst at the seams! This facility was meant to house 150 animals, but they currently have 400. With little money to repair the aging building, they need Bryan's help.
Brian’s self proclaimed laziness has left him and his wife Miki with a constructions site for a Kitchen. Miki can’t cook (which she loves) and Brian can’t eat her cooking (which he loves).

Graham has half done half of the bathroom and Heather has lost all her patients. Lose tiles and lack of direction has left her without relief. Can Bryan show Graham the way to fully refinish his bathroom?
Steve has promised Leslie a finished laundry room in the basement and not followed through. The lack of progress has made Leslie put her hopes out to dry. Will Bryan help Steve complete the job?
Justin needs no help starting the job, it’s the finishing that has escaped him. Holes in the floor, exposed heating ducts and a partially exposed brick wall are driving his wife Rachel crazy.

David Paquette has found himself and his 5 children living in a structurally compromised house. With no hot water and only a woodstove for heat Andrew Hamilton and the Local community reach out for the Bryan's help.
Part two of providing David Paquette and his 5 children with a dream home.
Bryan and Sarah Baeumler brave the tumultuous world of client builds. How will Sarah fare when faced with strict budgets and high expectations from homeowners?
Sarah struggles with client design choices. Bryan has to deliver a tough reality check.
A pet-project of Bryan’s proves to be a huge undertaking. The Baeumlers complete a client build.
When reno fatigue sets in for their clients, Bryan and Sarah have different approaches. The Baeumlers start a new family project.
Bryan and Sarah's largest client build gets off to a rocky start. The Baeumlers meet their most demanding client yet.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Earp rescues a new girl called Silver Dollar from an amorous man in front of the Alhambra where she works and takes her to Nellie Cashman for a new job.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: A boy and his mother from Mexico arrive in Tombstone asking Earp to turn over the body of his father who was murdered in Tombstone by a Mr. Granby.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: A string of murders occur at Tombstone caused by the Tucson Ten Percent Ring stealing the winning Arizona lottery tickets.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Earp must contend with Capt. Rowland who runs his own legal system on his property -- including a jail.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: An Army scout returns to Tombstone and finds his wife killed by the Apaches in retribution for his attacks on Apache renegades.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Billy Clanton arrives home unexpectedly from school in San Antonio. Emma wants Old Man Clanton to send him back to school but Billy and his brothers Phin and Ike have other ideas.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: With several hundred Chinese people in Tombstone, resentment brews among them about their treatment.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Earp has convinced Wells Fargo to use undercover agents to help protect shipments but the job is dangerous.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Earp learns Old Man Clanton is moving some of his stolen silver. Earp catches two of the gang and some silver but Sheriff Behan releases the men saying they escaped.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Old Man Clanton wants Emma to marry vicious outlaw Gringo Hawkby but Emma is against it. She turns to Nellie Cashman and Earp for help in persuading her father to change his mind.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Old Man Clanton gives Sheriff Behan orders to run John P. Clum out of town. Clanton is afraid important people might see Clum's paper and learn the truth.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: An elderly man confronts gunfighter Curt Dance in the Alhambra. Once Dance knows who he is, he wants nothing to do with the fight.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: After $40,000 is stolen from Wells Fargo's safe, a drunk Doc Holliday rides into Tombstone with $4000 in stolen bonds. Since he was named as one of the robbers, Earp is forced to arrest him.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: Army mule and horse remounts are stolen from a Tombstone stable. The owner was severely injured and didn't see the robbers but Roscoe did and was kicked by a stolen mule.

p.t: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
p.d: The San Berdoo gang is hitting Arizona on their way to Mexico. Earp dislikes posses but the size of the gang mandates one.
Al tries to ditch Peggy on her birthday until she catches him in the act and tags along with the family.
Peggy tries to earn her G.E.D. with Kelly in night school.
Kelly chooses to be a weather girl rather than go to school which makes the Bundy's happy since she'll be making more money than Al.

After being plagued by nightmares of feet a beautiful woman asks Al to judge a contest at Gary's, whose contestants she, could never compete with. Meanwhile, Kelly tricks Marcy and Bud into thinking they've slept together.

Peggy will buy anything at a yard sale, so when she brings home a boar's head, there's no more room in the garage to put it. So, Al decides enough is enough and he decides to have his own yard sale, despite Peggy's protests.
The Bundys decide to go for a drive--on Labor Day. They spend the better part of the holiday sitting in traffic, arguing with one another, and picking fights with neighboring motorists.
Al and Kelly feign illness to avoid going to Wanker County with Peg and Bud. Al looks forward to his quiet and peaceful weekend until Kelly gets sick.

Bud's new driver's license portends bumper cars on the roadway. When bud t-bones a Mercedes, Al sees an opportunity to clean up in court. At least he has hope. Losing his lawsuit hurt but what he goes through to pay off the settlement is truly painful.
Al is cut from the neighborhood softball team just before the big game. When his all-star replacement is knocked out in the last inning, however, his team and family have to come crawling back.
Peggy goes out dancing with Marcy and becomes taken with a handsome man-about-town named Andy. At home, however, Al gets confronted by Andy's wife, Pete.
Now an aspiring model, Kelly invents a maneuver called The Bundy Bounce for her first audition as spokesperson for the new Allente car.
After Al returns home from work with a bump on the head, he sees (or thinks he sees) six little green aliens coming down to Earth and stealing his smelly socks to use as fuel for their spaceships.
Al decides to grow a vegetable garden but soon faces off against an all-out war with a rabbit who steals his carrots and other vegetables.
When Al moves a sofa off a neighbor's lawn without a shirt on, he unexpectedly gains a reputation as a stud among the neighborhood women.
Tired of Al escorting her dates out through the doorway, grown-up Kelly gets her own apartment.
When testifying as a witness in a robbery case, Matlock is made to look like a fool. It soon becomes apparent that someone is playing tricks on him that threaten his credibility and safety.
Matlock is disturbed by frightening dreams that apparently give him clues to the murder of a doctor at a clinic patronized by celebrities. He even begins to wonder if he’s psychic.
It’s War of The Roses, Freudian style as divorcing psychiatrists forsake their couches for the courtroom. Matlock gets caught in the middle of a brutal battle that bruises more than egos.
When Matlock looks into the double murder of a man studying for the ministry and the stabbing death of his wife, it looks like the case is closed when the wife’s lover is charged.
When Matlock looks into the double murder of a man studying for the ministry and the stabbing death of his wife, it looks like the case is closed when the wife’s lover is charged.

Viewing a heated argument from his hotel window, Matlock witnesses a murder involving two stars of a local theater production and an unhappy husband. When he helps investigate the case, his memory becomes a bit blurred.

Director of an amateur stage production, Doug Michaels fires would-be actor Ben Matlock from his role as a detective, claiming he’s seen kumquats with more talent. However, the tables soon turn when Michaels is accused of murdering the leading lady.
It’s a race against time as Matlock tries to save conman Adam Spangler from being executed for a murder he claims he never committed.
Against Matlock’s approval, his associate, Cliff Lewis, advertises for a private client. He is hired by a flaky woman who becomes the main suspect in the murder of the plastic surgeon she sued.

After a failed attempt to kidnap Matlock’s daughter, the kidnappers take Matlock’s friend instead! Matlock tries to track down his friend, meanwhile, he’s asked to investigate the kidnapping of an eight-year-old boy.
What begins as a simple home burglary evolves into a very strange series of events for professional thief Kevin Gilliam.
The church choir hits a sour note when parishioner Wally McDaniels, is accused of murder. McDanielsturns to fellow choir member Ben Matlock to prove his innocence.
Amidst the beauty of a luxurious island mansion, a mystery game for charity quickly evolves into a puzzling murder when Matlock discovers the victim is really dead!

Ruby and Max disagree over the jack-o-lantern. Max helps Ruby find the perfect pumpkin. Ruby is determined not to be scared by Max's Halloween pranks.

After Flydubai Flight 981 nosedives into the runway at Russia's Rostov airport, investigators uncover one of the most lethal traps in aviation.
Near the end of its flight, Continental Express Flight 2574 suffers wing damage and goes into a dive falling out of the sky.
Ninety-five people die when TAM Airlines flight 402 crashes seconds after take-off; experts investigate what went wrong.
A look at stories from survivors of accidents.

Shimmer, Shine and Leah travel to a magical new land called Zahramay Skies and meet Adara, the Stardust Princess. But when Zeta shows up and lets all of Adara's stars loose, the girls must work together to retrieve the stars and save Zahramay Skies.

When Zeta traps the girls in a magic bubble, Tala, Nahal and Parisa team up with the girls' Zahracorns to free them. Shimmer, Shine and Leah meet Rubi, a Rainbow Genie-In-Training, whose rainbows quickly get out of control.

When costumes get magically stuck on Shimmer, Shine and Leah, they must track down a special feather to undo the magic. Zeta impersonates the girls' potions teacher and tricks them into helping her brew a sneaky potion.

Shimmer and Zahrora accidentally cause some trouble when they visit a new part of Zahramay Skies called Zahraconia. The girls meet Shaya's twin brother Shaun and help them when their magic combines to form a powerful Lightning Burst Cloud.

When flight magic disappears from Zahramay Skies, Rubi and the girls try to set things right, using rainbows to get around. When Zeta combines Daydream Dust with Dream Come True Dust, genies' daydreams start coming true and wreaking havoc.

When Zeta gets hold of a magical painting gem, she creates lots of troublesome art that the girls must get under control. When Leah accidentally wishes for the day to last forever, the kids must find a way to make the moon come up to end the day.

The girls partake in a Zahracorn Race. Zeta and Nazboo enter with a tiny, speedy Zahracorn named Tickles. The girls take Adara's Zahracorn to the salon, but must track her down when she gets spooked by all the salon magic.

When Adara's flowers won't bloom, the girls and their friend Minu travel to a Sky Garden to find a Zummingbird who can help. Shimmer, Shine, and Leah travel to the Dragon Forest as they help Shaun track down an elusive, magical creature.

Zeta and Zac get trapped inside a magic bottle and must find a way out before all their friends get sucked inside too! Zeta tries to stop the kids from finding her secret lair when she sees them hunting for gems in the area.

Shimmer, Shine and Leah explore the Dragon Forest and meet Farnaz, a Dragon Rider who teaches them to ride dragons! But when Zeta takes a flock of dragons, including Farnaz's, the girls and Farnaz must work together to stop her before it's too late.

When the girls bake a cake with bouncing flour, it bounces off and they must catch it in time for Roya's Feather Day party! A potion spill turns Rocket's barks magical. But when the magic gets out of control, the kids must find a way to stop it.

A stinky bug infestation in Zeta's secret lair forces her to spend the night at Shimmer and Shine's Palace. Zeta and Nazboo have to take care of Shimmer, Shine, and Leah when a potion mishap turns them into little babies.

Zeta uses a Zahracorn suit to sneak her, Nazboo, and his family into the Zahracorn Parade, but the disguise goes haywire! Zeta grows jealous when Nazboo gets an enchanted robe that allows him to do magic.

When Zeta's sister comes to visit, Zeta is shocked to discover that her once sorcerific sister is now a genie! When Samira sends the girls out on a fun quest, Zeta tricks them into finding a bunch of magical items for her instead.

An enchanted treasure map leads Shimmer, Shine, Leah, and their Dragon Rider friend Farnaz to the powerful Dragon Gem. But when Zeta gets ahold of the gem, it's up to Farnaz and the girls to get it back before Zeta becomes too powerful to stop.
Dr. C is split into two through his new teleportation machine. Can the Monsters reunite the wild and brainy roaches before it's too late?
Sqweep fashions a canine brainwave device to make B.O.B. the perfect pet. It works great on everyone on the base but B.O.B.
Dr. C doubles his strength, but lessens his genius. Can the other Monsters save him before it's too late?
When Dr. C invents a living smart-phone, Coverton diabolically plans to use the smart-phone to hack the base's mainframe.

It's April Fool's Day at Area Fifty-Something as Susan tries to prevent the Monsters from destroying the base with a prank! Dr. C's Ph.D is in jeopardy as a former teacher reveals a missing music grade in his transcript.
A new alien, Sta'abi, comes to Earth in search of a ferocious beast called Vornicarn. Soon, everyone is on a chase in order to save the planet from Vornicarn's terror!
Susan is in a bind after spilling food on Sta'abi and apologizing about it. Insulted, Sta'abi hunts Susan to feed her fralnick to Vornicarn.

Strange secrets begin to unfold when Derek returns to expose our friends at Area Fifty Something. Monger is away for the weekend! This is great news for Team Monster and Team Alien until they're introduced to Rule-Bot.
Link and Sta'abi duel for driving privileges of a new supercar. Sqweep wants to drive too though, and takes off on a supersonic joyride.
With everyone down with alien flu, Coverton tries to steal base secrets, but fails to account for a huge gelatinous hallucinating B.O.B. Vornicarn's bad behavior lands him in the Isolation Zone.
B.O.B. eats Dr. C's probabilitator and foresees Coverton with a crown, but soon Coverton discovers the painful truth about his future.

Sqweep has to go number seven. Team Monster fears the destruction it will cause and sets out to contain it! Link pursues Sta'abi using a pheromone spray of Sqweep's design that ends up having unforeseen consequences.

Susan and Bob play detective when Dr. Cutter arrives to update the base's technology. Link and Bob find an old spaceship that they take on a joyride, but things go bad when Coverton spots them and alarms the base of a hostile alien invasion.
After hacking into Monger's top secret files, the monsters learn that there was supposed to be another member of the team: The Man-Beast!
A stray kitten makes its way onto the base and accidently obtains Susan's ginormica powers! Sta'abi recruits Bob to teach her the Art of Combat, after she witnesses him winning Link's new video game.

Zoro's barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.

Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!

An army of scantily-clad women warriors want to investigate Luffy's family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.
The women chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she's about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!

p.t: In the Heat of the Night
p.d: (1/2) When Virgil Tibbs joins the Sparta, MI, police, resentment festers in Chief of Police Bill Gillespie. (2/2) After Nan and, subsequently, Willie Jones' murders, racial tensions are especially high in Sparta.

p.t: In the Heat of the Night
p.d: Police Chief Bill Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Chief of Detectives Virgil Tibbs (Howard Rollins) are at odds when Tibbs suspects that Gillespie's old friend, Sonny Mims, killed his wife because of his involvement with the dead woman's cousin.

p.t: In the Heat of the Night

p.t: In the Heat of the Night

p.t: In the Heat of the Night

p.t: In the Heat of the Night
p.d: The Sparta jail descends into complete and utter chaos when the six wives of a bigamist (guest star Ted Lange) all show up to visit and shower him with gifts. But when the man turns up dead in his cell, which of his wives turns out to be a murderer?

p.t: In the Heat of the Night
p.d: An escaped convict and his girlfriend leave a trail of bodies in their wake as they travel through Mississippi and eventually take Althea and Scooter, the grandson of one of their victims, as hostages in a desperate bid for freedom.

p.t: In the Heat of the Night

Gregg investigates Hack Green Bunker for the first time and is immediately struck by its intense atmosphere. During his exploration, he may have captured the voice of a woman rumored to have died there under tragic circumstances.

A doctor treats three gunshot victims who claim to be innocent bystanders; on his first day on the job, a doctor must perform emergency brain surgery in the ER; a young bride-to-be suddenly slips into a diabetic coma.

A woman stops eating because she believes she is dead; a runner goes blind in one eye during a marathon and takes a detour to the ER; doctors are baffled by an ER tech's stroke-like symptoms, until someone he loves also becomes ill.

An anesthesiologist has a heart attack; a pregnant woman has a cerebral aneurysm; doctors are sprayed with blood from a man who was stabbed in the heart; a prostitute's unusual hiding place for money is found.
An 82-year-old woman appears to have committed suicide by overdosing on painkillers, but Dr. G finds evidence that suggests that she may have died of a heart attack.
Dr. G performs an autopsy on an alleged hit-and-run victim but finds no evidence of vehicular injury on the 41-year-old man's body. Could his alcoholism have had a role in his death?
A 94-year-old woman dies in the hospital after having a convulsion. The case becomes the business of the medical examiner's office when no one will sign her death certificate.
An infant and his two-year-old sister are found dead in a house shared by two families. At first, they are believed to have died from either carbon monoxide poisoning or cold medicine overdoses.
A decomposing body is found in a pond and a tent is found nearby. Dr. G performs the autopsy in the morgue but finds few clues other than fingerprints and mouthwash in the stomach.
Police patrolling the night streets hear gunshots and head to the scene. They find a nude middle-aged man in a parking lot lying face down in a puddle of blood.
While in the process of adopting a five-week-old baby, a mother takes him to work with her. While there, the baby inexplicably obtains a skull fracture while unsupervised.
On a Texas highway, a fire is discovered having burnt three bodies beyond recognition. Dr. G finds bullets in the bodies and determines that they were all shot before being set on fire.

The four farmers head out on their second solo dates.

Between 1996-1999, women disappear in Truth or Consequences, NM. The escape of a chained woman leads authorities to a couple’s gruesome “Toy Box” of torture.
In 1985, a shoplifting case in South San Francisco leads police to a year-long trail of missing people and a horrifying discovery of a secret sex bunker and videotaped torture.
He was destined for crime, she was spoiled and affluent. Together, they embarked on a shocking crime spree in 1978, becoming one of the most notorious criminal duos of the century.
In 1998, LAPD uncovers a businessman’s murder connected to a con-artist mother and son duo. They set up a massive sting in NYC to stop them before they kill again.
In 1977, Colleen Stan’s hitchhike turns into a seven-year nightmare of abuse with Cameron and Janice Hooker. As time passes, her situation blurs the lines of captivity.
A Michigan man’s shocking tale about his ex-wife’s confession to killing five patients leaves police questioning if they’re dealing with killers or a scorned lover’s revenge.
Alvin, a fun-loving man, and Judith, his troubled young wife, escalate from petty crime to murder, revealing the dark forces driving their violent rampage.
Bones found on a farm in Missouri lead to a deadly cattle scheme. As police dig deeper, they uncover a grisly trail of human remains and a murderous plot.
In 1984, a brutal couple wreaks havoc across the Midwest with a spree of robbery, rape, and murder. Police race to stop them before more lives are claimed.
In 1980, LA police hunt a serial killer targeting runaways. The discovery of a decapitated man’s body raises fears of a copycat or an even more dangerous accomplice.

When Genora Guillory is murdered in her home, investigators find several suspects on the Louisiana woman’s final 24-hour timeline. Unable to pin anyone down, the case goes cold… until a witness comes forward with the inside story of ‘the perfect murder.’

When firefighters extinguish the flames of an apartment fire, they discover the charred remains of Missy Grubaugh. Several of her coworkers soon come under scrutiny, and Detectives must use the timeline to determine which one of them is the killer.

When a nursing student is shot dead outside a Houston community college, the search is on for a brazen shooter in a red car. Detectives retrace the last 24 hours of the victim’s life, and unearth a number of potential suspects.

The body of a 16-year-old high school cheerleader is found floating in a river bordering Texas and Oklahoma. The police investigation unearths several promising suspects, before an unexpected break points to a killer already in their midst.

Popular newlyweds Rick and Gail Brink are shot execution-style in their Michigan home. But it will take 25 years before investigators uncover a flaw in the timeline that convinces them of the killer’s guilt.
To net a thousand-dollar reward and save a friend, Josh saves Tolliver Bender from hanging so he can testify in a nearby trial.
An attractive woman hires Josh for $1000 to clear her father on a false murder charge in a town that is not very welcoming to Josh.
Josh and Jason are hired to chase a killer who went to Mexico by his brother who is about to hang for a crime his brother committed.
Mary likes the attention of many men, but that soon causes troubles the town when one is murdered over her.
The holdup-proof safe in Gus Lammerson's store proves anything but.
A West Point graduate has trouble adjusting to an Army unit in the West.
Gambler Bill Gentry is the prime suspect when a mail carrier is murdered — and the only witness is a dog.
Two thieves cause trouble after they overhear an intriguing conversation between a couple of businessmen.
A man's resemblance to a killer lands him in jail and facing a murder charge.
A raging snowstorm holds more than one danger for Maggie and her father: they must take refuge with murderers.
Stagecoach driver Abe Williamson hunts down two outlaws who robbed his stagecoach.
Ex-outlaw Belle Starr goes after the D.A. who ridiculed her illiterate husband.
Immigrant Rafe Pegarski gives his teacher a family heirloom, a gold pocket watch, in return for schooling.
A man who claims he can resurrect the dead poses a problem for killer Bill Groat.
A reporter probes reports that a general is selling guns to Natives in exchange for their property.
When a strange virus quickly spreads through a safari park and turns all the zoo animals undead, those left in the park must stop the creatures before they escape and zombify the whole city.

The group is confronted by the inhabitants of Zona.

When Sun Mei and Red vanish, the group must decide whether to keep looking for them or press on to Newmerica.
Following Warren's dream, the team doesn't stop while crossing a seemingly endless landscape of destruction.
The team is captured by a mysterious entity and enslaved in an elaborate underground facility.
