Sean and craft-enthusiast Lisa have loved living in their Calgary suburban home for over six years. The house has a large finished basement, good bones, and is close to their family. But...

Though a couple fell in love with their suburban Las Vegas home 18 years ago, raising sons has taken its toll and it's now tired and severely outdated; the brothers come up with a plan that's ready for the next chapter.
Allie and Ben’s home has been in her family for over 60 years, and they’re ready to continue their family traditions while maximizing the home’s potential.
The house of a single mom lacks space for teenage hangouts and family baking sessions - two things that are near to her heart.
Rina and Nilesh were newlyweds when they bought their home seven years ago.
After downsizing to a modest home so they could afford to foster children and raise their own, a couple's house is in desperate need of an overhaul.

Amber and Alex are high school sweethearts who wasted no time finding their L.A. dream home: a bungalow that’s close to both of their families, who they wanted to have over for holidays and get-togethers.

Jackie and JR's dream of being parents comes true when they have girls, but they delay mp4ing to a new home because it needs a complete overhaul. Drew and Jonathan rework multiple spaces to create more flow.
A Nashville family is desperate to get out of a bedroom and into a forever home of their own.
Despite the roadblocks along the way, Sarah Richardson and her husband, Alex, are almost ready to open their Whistler, British Columbia, vacation rental.
It’s the storm before the calm as Sarah Richardson and her husband, Alex, hustle to complete the exterior makeover of Haus Heidi, their luxury nightly rental in Whistler, British Columbia.
The HGTV Canada Home to Win facelift finishes with a dining room renovation, courtesy of designer Mia Parres and builder Sebastian Clovis.
In the Season 1 finale, three hopefuls compete in a series of challenges to decide the winner of the property that was designed and renovated by 20 HGTV Canada all-stars.
House hunting has never been more entertaining as Bryan Baeumler and Scott McGillivray scour the shoreline in search of this season’s Home to Win.

Designer Danielle Bryk and contractor Rob Evans look to add lakeside flare in the powder and laundry rooms, while design expert Samantha Pynn joins builder Joey Fletcher to bring the outdoors into the garage

Deck master Paul Lafrance teams up with the queen of colour, Tiffany Pratt, to design a sophisticated yet soulful living room while interior expert Danielle Bryk partners with DIY specialist Sebastian Clovis
Design maven Mia Parres and builder Colin Hunter join forces with savvy stylist Sarah Baeumler and renovator Dave Kenney to create lakeside luxury in the master suite.
Design authority Samantha Pynn teams up with builder Kate Campbell for a nautical take on the kids’ bedroom.
Design diva Jo Alcorn and builder Mike Holmes Jr. create a magical home theatre while interior expert Mia Parres pairs with contractor Brian McCourt for a dramatic take on a dreamy guest suite.
DIY authorities Tiffany Pratt and Sebastian Clovis lean on childhood memories to inspire the perfect playroom.
Three Canadians have been chosen to go head-to-head for the keys to the spectacular, fully-furnished waterfront property.
Twenty HGTV Canada stars work together to renovate a home; three Canadians compete to win it.
Carson joins Paul and his team to help create a picturesque outdoor oasis.

Make It Right Mike Holmes Jr. teams up with designer Sarah Keenleyside to create a chic yet soulful living room, while builder Sebastian Clovis reforms the coffin-like pool with design diva, Jo Alcorn.
A firehouse kitchen has not changed since the 1940s.
Building a giant chopper over a two-week span with help and advice from Billy Lane and Arlen Ness. Host: Frank Payne.
Building the biggest claw game ever displayed at the San Diego County Fair, measuring nearly 19 feet high and weighing about 5,000 pounds.
Using a standard backyard charcoal barbecue grill as a model, the team builds a giant grill that stands 20 feet high, 20 feet wide and weighs 3,500 pounds.
The team builds the world's biggest hair clippers during a five-day span.
Frank's 12-foot cuckoo-clock is tested against a digital clock.
The team is challenged to build a giant toaster and make big bread to put in it; visiting Tropical Jelly.
Building the world's biggest treadmill in the course of five days.
Wardens track a potential poacher who took a deer out of season; a warden as he takes his son hunting.
Wardens deal with a trespassing incident and an early hunting violation in Montana.
Nick Taylor looks for out-of-town hunters accused of trespassing and illegally killing a mule deer; Lee Burrows responds to a panicked deer hunter calling about a kill.
The wardens investigate a possible elk harassment case and possible poaching in Montana.
Three wardens act on a report of a large alligator who has taken up residence in a lake recreation area.
A warden's K-9 tracker bites a suspected marijuana grower; wardens track a pig poacher; surveillance on a woman suspected of feeding bears.

As their time in Alaska comes to a close, Kaid and R.L. reflect on what matters most in their lives and what they've learned about being alive. Lifelong friendships are solidified as the men prepare to be lifted out of Alaska.
Jeremy Wade takes on Africa's wild Zambezi River to unmask an invisible predator that is dragging fisherman to their deaths.

On a volcanic island in the Pacific, terror grips a fishing community when something in the water leaves a trail of bloody victims in its wake. The only clues they have to the attacker's identity are the large puncture wounds it left behind.
A disturbing report from Southeast Asia of something in the water that's sliced through a young man is enough to lure Jeremy Wade to the shores of the Mekong.
Wade faces one of his greatest fears to uncover increasing missing persons cases.
Terrifying reports surface of a creature terrorising the Florida Keys. Jeremy Wade sets off to the Sunshine State to find out what is triggering these unusual attacks.
Jeremy heads to the rivers of Southeast Asia in search of the mythological sea serpent. Jeremy needs to put his freshwater knowledge to the test if he is to tackle this monster of the deep.

Two men mysteriously vanish on a remote lake in Malaysia just hours apart. Amid rumours that a giant fish is on the loose, biologist and monster-hunter Jeremy Wade sets out to track down the possible culprit.
Expert navigation through dense jungle and political unrest is needed as Jeremy Wade heads to Colombia to investigate a creature blamed for killing a bride in the Amazon.
For years fishermen have been vanishing in Alaska's remote wilderness. For Jeremy Wade, a recent incident sends him on a search for possible suspects.
Wade hunts for the Lau-lau, a creature said to swallow men whole.
Jeremy Wade visits Thailand in search of one of the world's most terrifying river fish, the Giant Freshwater Stingray. Armed with a venomous tail, it tests Jeremy to his limit.
A behind-the-scenes episode where Jeremy reveals just what it takes to move river monsters into the open ocean and the crew opens up about their struggles on board.
Jeremy Wade returns to Africa's Okavango Delta to investigate a pack-hunting carnivore blamed for mauling the victims of a capsized boat.

In the deep South lives a fish reputed to have committed a series of violent attacks on humans, said to be as vicious as a shark and as big as a gator. Extreme angler Jeremy Wade heads to Texas to reveal the truth about the alligator gar.
Extreme angler Jeremy Wade is on the trail of a monster that leads him to the site of the worst nuclear accident in history - Chernobyl.
The cleanup crew on a boat with a cursed past comes face to face with its haunted history.
An exterminator’s assistant discovers a nest of monstrous bugs.
A limousine veers into a classified military installation and activates a defense system.
A chemical spill in the lab could lead to deadly consequences.
A group of campers is carjacked by a ravenous beast.
A young woman takes a taxi ride from Hell when her driver turns violent.
A young man cleaning the lab of a mad scientist unleashes a terrifying creation.
A young man cleaning up an animal testing facility unleashes an experimental creature.
A ghostly image in a bathroom mirror comes to life and terrifies two young women.
Two movers stumble upon a deadly sibling rivalry.
A party-planner becomes mixed up with a group of cult members during an event.
A home care worker’s new charge turns out to be dangerously unstable.
An employee at a magic shop is terrified when a homicidal magician shows up.
A babysitter is shocked when a vengeful garden gnome comes to life.
A group of partygoers is left at the mercy of an escaped maniac with a vendetta.

p.t: South Park: La grenouille mexicaine hypnotique du sud du Sri Lanka
p.d: Jimbo et Ned animent une émission sur la chasse sur une chaîne du câble.

p.t: South Park: La Ville au bord de l'Eternité
p.d: Le bus scolaire est coincé face à une falaise. Mlle Crabtree va chercher de l'aide et devient alors une vedette.
Alors que Jimbo et Ned veulent faire des feux d'artifice pour le 4 juillet, M. Garrison s'aperçoit que M. Toc a disparu et qu'il est 'son côté gay'.

p.t: South Park: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé
p.d: Le festival de Sundance arrive à South Park. Mais les festivaliers étouffent M. Hankey avec leurs déjections pleines de nourriture bio.
Les parents de South Park décident de donner la varicelle à leurs enfants pour éviter qu'ils ne l'attrapent vieux.

p.t: South Park: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras
p.d: La classe de Mr. Garrison est emmenée au planétarium de South Park, qui est un lieu des plus ennuyeux.
Alors que Stan doit construire une garçonnière pour jouer à 'action ou vérité' avec Wendy, ses parents se séparent.
C'est la fête de la vache à South Park. La programmation inclut rodéo et fête foraine.
Chef a été spolié: on lui a volé des droits sur ses chansons.
Tante Flo, la sœur de Sharon Marsh, offre à son neveu un poisson rouge. Mais Stan découvre que c'est en réalité un serial killer.

p.t: South Park: Joyeux Noël Charlie Manson
p.d: Kyle, Kenny et Cartman s'en vont pour les fêtes de Noël dans le Nebraska pour aller rendre visite à la grand-mère de Cartman.
Mr. Tweek risque de perdre son café à cause de la concurrence des cafés Harbucks.
Les garçons sont envoyés dans la forêt tropicale du Costa Rica avec les enfants de la chorale.
Les citoyens de South Park prennent feu sans explication. Trouvera-t-on la cause de ces combustions spontanées?

p.t: South Park: La Maman de Chef
p.d: Depuis que Chef a rencontré la fille de ses rêves, les garçons se sentent delaissés.
The children of South Park are attracted to Mr. Jefferson, the new neighbor in town, and Cartman goes out of his way to get Mr. Jefferson to love him best.
Humans from the year 4035 are traveling to South Park through a recently opened time portal and are looking for work.
A PETA protest against the use of a cow as South Park Elementary's mascot forces the student body to choose a new one.
In order to save South Park, Stan and Kyle have to find a way to destroy the ever-expanding Wall-Mart superstore while keeping Cartman from stabbing them in the back.
The kid who took the fall for the boys five years ago is getting out of Juvie, and his first order of business is revenge.
The boys of South Park produce their own morning news show on the school's closed-circuit television station and are immediately caught up in an intense competition for ratings.
Disturbed by the corruptive influence Paris Hilton has on all little girls in South Park, one of the town's favorite citizens challenges her to a 'whore-off.'
After sustaining a severe head injury, Cartman appears to have the power to see into the future. South Park detectives are quick to enlist his help in cracking unsolved murder cases.
Stan agrees to help a group of adorable woodland critters build a manger in anticipation of the birth of their Lord and Savior, only to find out that they serve Satan.
As Mr. Garrison enjoys his new womanly attributes after his sex change, the rest of the town gets in touch with their inner feelings too.
When hippie drum circles start popping up in people's attics and backyards the citizens of South Park have no choice but to turn to Eric Cartman for help.
The boys set up a talent agency and pool all their resources and impress their first client only to have another agency steal him away.
Kenny is the only one of his friends to get the newest, coolest portable gaming device and Cartman can't deal with it. Will they remain best friends forever?
The kids desperately want an end to the boring baseball season. The problem is, they keep winning.
Cartman is sure he's dead and Butters is sure that Eric Cartman's ghost is haunting him. Together they attempt to make amends to all the people Cartman has wronged over the years.
Cartman is pursued by the FBI for committing a hate crime and lands in juvenile hall.
Cartman decides to seek friendship using the Internet and finds an older man who is more than willing to be his friend...and more.
Cartman's family and friends have intervened and are forcing him to trim down. While Cartman's away, Kenny's star is on the rise when he gets his own reality TV show.
After the other boys explain to Cartman that pubes don't count unless you grow your own, Cartman realizes he's been tricked by the school bully, Scott Tenorman.
Cartman inherits a million dollars from his grandmother and fulfills his lifelong dream of owning his own amusement park: Cartmanland!
Cartman plans to learn all of Butters' innermost secrets and then use them against him, by pretending to be Butters' new best friend, a robot named AWESOM-O.
After sustaining a severe head injury, Cartman appears to have the power to see into the future. South Park detectives are quick to enlist his help in cracking unsolved murder cases.
Cartman is sure he's dead and Butters is sure that Eric Cartman's ghost is haunting him. Together they attempt to make amends to all the people Cartman has wronged over the years.
After the sudden on-set of the disease Gingervitis, Cartman rallies all other ginger kids to rise up and assume their role as the master race.
Al Gore warns the school about the threat of Manbearpig.
When Cartman's mom realizes she can't control her son anymore, she gets help from an expert. The Dog Whisperer may have what it takes but Eric Cartman's not going down without a fight.

South Park Elementary faces strong opposition to the topic of evolution. Cartman's too busy to notice as he plans to propel himself into the future on the precise release date of the newest, hottest game console.

Eric Cartman has frozen himself in an attempt to make his three-week wait for a Nintendo Wii pass quickly. A freak accident landed him over 500 years in the future and now, he's stuck in a Godless world on the brink of war with no Nintendo Wii.

When his ultimate plan to embarrass Butters backfires, Cartman struggles to keep his classmates from seeing a compromising photograph. Meanwhile, Butters is sent to a special camp where they Pray the Gay Away.

Cartman discovers the joys of having Tourette’s syndrome. Drunk with the power of saying whatever he wants without getting in trouble for it, he lines up national TV coverage to take advantage of his new life with no filters.

The boys try to rescue their new friend Willzyx, a talking space whale, from the Denver Sea Park, and with the help of MASA (Mexican Aeronautica y Spacia Administracion) get him home to the moon for $200.
Kyle and his family are moving to San Francisco. The only way Stan can get his best friend back is to convince everyone to start driving hybrid cars.
When the entire contents of the world’s imagination lay open before them, Stan and Kyle step right in. Back in South Park, Cartman swears he’s seen a leprechaun.

Stan and Kyle are being held in the bowels of the Pentagon until they tell the government how they got into Imaginationland. Meanwhile, Cartman simply won’t rest until he finds Kyle and gets him to make good on their bet to suck his balls.

Inside Imaginationland, Stan and Butters engage in the battle of their lives as they fight the army of evil imaginary forces. Meanwhile, Cartman goes all the way to the Supreme Court to get Kyle to pay up on their bet.
Stan and Kyle are hooked on Guitar Hero. Unfortunately, Stan’s superior skills on the video game damage his friendship with Kyle.
The girls in the fourth grade class have made a secret list that rates every boy’s looks from cutest to ugliest. When the boys steal the list, they are completely unprepared to deal with the results.
Randy steps forward with a solution to fix the desperate state of the economy.
Stan takes action to stop the Japanese from killing the world’s whales and dolphins.
The latest in scientific testing reveals that some of the boys at South Park Elementary have a sex addiction problem.
New Jersey is taking over the nation one state at a time. Randy and the boys take a stand as the Jerseyites approach South Park.
Kyle is intimately involved in the development of a revolutionary new product called HumancentiPad.
Kyle gets in on the ground floor of Cartman’s latest business venture, The Crack Baby Athletic Association.
The boys are getting close to discovering the truth about the first Thanksgiving.
When Ike hits puberty, he and Kyle start to grow apart. To save their relationship, Kyle takes Ike to see a live performance of Yo Gabba Gabba.
Stan agrees to help a group of adorable woodland critters build a manger in anticipation of the birth of their Lord and Savior, only to find out that they serve Satan.

Scientologists converge on Stan's house after he is identified as the reincarnation of L. Ron Hubbard. One A-lister locks himself in the closet and refuses to come out after Stan criticizes his 'talent.'
Stan Marsh has hit rock bottom. He's got no job, no bicycle, and his only way out of a bad situation is to coach the local peewee hockey team.
Determined to get the real story behind why he has to decorate eggs for Easter, Stan falls in with an eccentric society that guards a legendary secret.
Stan and Kyle are hooked on Guitar Hero. Unfortunately, Stan’s superior skills on the video game damage his friendship with Kyle.
The citizens of South Park wake up and find the internet is gone. When Randy hears there may still be some internet out in California, he packs up his family and heads west.
Randy steps forward with a solution to fix the desperate state of the economy.
Randy has a plan that will assure Stan a first place trophy in this year’s Pinewood Derby.
Stan takes action to stop the Japanese from killing the world’s whales and dolphins.
When Kyle begs Stan to friend him, Stan gets sucked into Facebook.
When Stan is sent to the school counselor because he’s holding on to an obscene number of useless possessions, he realizes that Mr. Mackey has a hoarding disorder too.
Randy’s obsession with the Food Network forces Sharon to explore a new interest of her own.
Just after Stan’s 10th birthday, his worldview starts to change and so do his friendships.
Cartman finds a unique way to cope with Asperger's Syndrome.
Cartman launches his own gem shopping channel.
Kyle gets in on the ground floor of Cartman’s latest business venture, The Crack Baby Athletic Association.
When Ike hits puberty, he and Kyle start to grow apart. To save their relationship, Kyle takes Ike to see a live performance of Yo Gabba Gabba.
Stan is addicted to the new Terrance and Phillip mobile game.
Garrison wants to build a wall to keep out all of the undocumented immigrants.
It’s never been more challenging to be a PC Principal.
The children of South Park claim to have seen Mr. Garrison lurking around town. The townspeople are angry that the president is scaring their children.
Grandpa's sole birthday wish is for Stan to take part in his assisted suicide. Meanwhile, Mrs. Broflovski has organized a protest against the boys' favorite TV show, Terrance and Phillip.
Mistaking Cartman for a starving African child, government authorities send him to Ethiopia where he runs into Sally Struthers.
Terrance and Phillip must save Terrance's Little Daughter, Sally, and all of Canada from an evil dictator.
The kids' parents only have their best interests at heart when they arrange for Stan, Kyle and Cartman to be exposed to the chickenpox virus.
South Park's 14th Annual Cow Days rodeo and carnival is here and the boys are determined to win Terrance and Phillip dolls.
When Sharon Marsh's Aunt Flo makes a monthly visit, she brings a mysterious pet fish for Stan.
Dinner with Cartman's family takes a bizarre twist when Uncle Howard shows up after breaking out of prison with the help of his cellmate, Charlie Manson.
When Timmy is diagnosed with Attention Deficit Disorder, it triggers a wave of prescription drug abuse at South Park Elementary.
When the boys discover Terrance and Philip have called it quits, they'll go to any lengths to reunite the duo and recruit them for South Park's Earth Day festivities.

The team discovers a device created by the Ancients that, without warning, pulls Sheppard in. As the team scrambles to release him from the strange place he is stuck in, McKay discovers that time moves differently inside.

The team races to foil the Goa'uld's plans to destroy Atlantis after Maj. Gen. Landry informs them that a bomb has been planted, triggered to detonate the next time the team heads to Earth. Meanwhile, two Wraith ships are heading towards Atlantis.

While testing a newly repaired puddle jumper, McKay and Captain Hugh Griffin suddenly lose control of the ship and crash into the ocean. As the jumper begins to sink slowly towards the bottom of the ocean, Griffin sacrifices himself to save McKay.

Sheppard and the team discover a world that has technology created by the Ancients. But the planet's royal family does not allow anyone but them to harness the technology and treat the villagers with little dignity.

The team discover two life pods floating in space. Upon further investigation, the team accidentally transfers the minds of the individuals into Sheppard and Weir. Things get worse when the team discovers the two people are out to destroy the other.

After Netan (Eric Steinberg), and the Lucian Alliance, are undermined by SG-1 yet again, he decides to put a bounty out on their heads. Starring Ben Browder, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge, Claudia Black, Beau Bridges, and Michael Shanks.

Mistaken for rebels on an alien planet, SG-1 must play the part of hostage takers in hopes to buy themselves enough time to be rescued before they're executed. Starring Ben Browder, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge, and Michael Shanks.

Barely surviving the bombing massacre of a peaceful Jaffa summit, Teal'c (Christopher Judge) must go rogue to track down and stop a Jaffa leader named Arkad (Craig Fairbrass) who plans to take control of the Jaffa nation and deliver them to the Ori.

Vala's (Claudia Black) father Jacek (guest star Fred Willard) contacts Stargate Command wishing to trade information about a series of planned attacks on Earth in exchange for sanctuary on the planet. Also starring Ben Browder and Michael Shanks.

In an elaborate plan using Vala Mal Doran (Claudia Black) as bait to capture Adria (guest star Morena Baccarin), SG-1 themselves are surprised when Ba'al (guest star Cliff Simon) intercepts Adria from under them to use in his own evil plan.

With extinction imminent, the Asgard hand over all their knowledge and technology to SG-1, but not before the Ori launch an attack trying to intercede. Starring Ben Browder, Amanda Tapping, Christopher Judge, Beau Bridges, and Michael Shanks.
Struggling real estate agent Mandy discovers her true passion and love, when she inherits her grandfather's bowling alley, teams up with a local vet, and finds a lost kitten along the way.
A dangerous windstorm wreaks havoc on Hudson.
Amy and Ty worry about the impact a surprise visitor will have on Luke.
Elizabeth's book is finally published, and it is the talk of the town; Lucas plans a surprise party to celebrate the event, but some bad book reviews have Elizabeth in a less social mood.
Elizabeth sees a new side of Lucas when a flu bug leaves her without a babysitter, and he volunteers to watch Little Jack.
An aspiring marketing designer's favorite foster dog is adopted by a famous, but down-on-his-luck furniture designer, whom she fears only wants the dog for his new image.
A letter from beyond the grave brings new hope and life to an estranged family.
The postal detectives are faced with a challenge when a letter from the futures turns up.
When Celeste loses her teaching job, she becomes an au pair for an infamous New York property tycoon.

Lexi has two weeks before she takes her rightful place as a royal princess. She must reveal her true identity to her best friend and find a suitable date for the royal gala, all under the watchful eye of her handsome, but infuriating, bodyguard Noah.
Georgie's graduation has finally arrived but so has a mysterious figure from her past.
Amy is asked to spend time at an art retreat to work with an artist's allegedly traumatized horse.

Hoping to boost her career, a celebrity agrees to go on a reality TV show to marry her perfect match, a man she's never met. She soon tries to track him down to clarify that the marriage is just for show.

On the brink of divorce, James and Michelle have drifted apart over the years. They wake up to discover they have somehow switched bodies. Unable to switch back, they are forced to understand what the other goes through on a daily basis.
Tim is organizing an important rodeo when an old flame blows back into Hudson asking for his help.

(S06E001) Faced with the constant threat of flooding and exhaustive heat, not to mention the flesh-eating piranhas, new rules are introduced for the sixth installment of TV's most popular reality series.
(S06E002) The discovery of hidden food threatens to send one tribe over the edge.
(S06E003) The women elect a team leader who has no desire to be put in that position.
(S06E004) A tribe member, who seemingly has no allies, rethinks strategy.
(S06E005) Just when the tribes begin to settle in their environment, a surprise tempts the existing alliances within the tribes.
(S06E006) One castaway forms an alliance with a hated tribe member whom they fully intend to betray.
(S06E007) With the ousting of Roger, Dave acknowledges that he’s on thin ice with the tribe and realizes he needs to form a new strategy to stay.
(S06E008) Dave turns to the Heidi in hopes of forming an alliance.

Latka blows his life's savings on a luxurious penthouse when his apartment is demolished.
Alex's romantic affair with a television soap actress leads to thoughts of matrimony.
Latka decides to return to his native country to fight in a revolution.

Elaine suddenly starts getting mysterious love letters. When she becomes intrigued by the poetic propositions, a couple of cabbies quickly claim responsibility, leaving Elaine with the hilarious task of discovering who is the amorous writer.
Louie makes a horrible first impression on girlfriend Zena’s parents on Taxi. Louie’s romance with girlfriend Zena takes an outrageous twist when she brings him home to meet her parents.

It’s a hilarious shock to the cabbies when Rev. Jim brings his new pet to the garage—an over-the-hill racehorse that he bought after cashing in on the 300-to-1 long shot. However, he soon finds that it’s impossible to housebreak a horse.
It’s a dream come true for Tony when he’s challenged by an aging ex-champ, but he has more than just a fight on his hand when the opposition unveils its secret weapon.
The cabbies try to make Tony a family man when they convince him to adopt the adorably precocious eight-year-old boy named Brian whom he befriended.
Romantic sparks fly when Latka meets Simka Dahblitz, who is from his native country.

Bobby faces a humorous predicament when it becomes obvious that one of the biggest talent managers in New York is representing him because of his prowess as a lover, and not for his ability as an actor.
In a protest against unsafe equipment, the cabbies go on strike, and Louie offers an unusual solution to the problem to shop steward Elaine.
Shop steward Elaine settles the strike by agreeing to Louie's deal.
A woman questions Alex's courage; he becomes a daredevil and has an exciting ski-trip; he decides to live life to the fullest from then on and signs up for skydiving for the first time.

In a hilarious caper, Louie and the cabbies pool all their cash to buy a painting at an auction, planning to cash in big when the artist dies—but when the bidding gets too heavy, the gang turns a dignified auction into a frolicking free-for-all.
The cabbies conjure up their own outrageous fantasies when Herve Villechaize of Fantasy Island leaves an envelope in Tony's cab.
Guest star Howard Morris plays the part of a mountain man very disgruntled with being rejected by the army.
A visiting preacher urges the residents of Mayberry to relax and enjoy the simple pleasures of life--leading to more work for all.
Aunt Bee is the unwilling object of matrimony when mountaineer Briscoe Darling comes a'courting.
Gossiping Gomer Pyle moves in with the sheriff when he loses his job and home at the filling station.
Ron Howard's real-life father and younger brother appear as Mayberry gets involved with a gold shipment en route to Fort Knox.
Opie seems in line for a new bicycle as he comes home with an all A report card.
Barney Fife plays cupid for Gomer when Barney's girl refuses to go to a dance unless her cousin also has a date.
Barney is evicted from his rooming house for illegal cooking and moves into the Mayberry sheriff's office backroom much to Andy's chagrin.
Barney tickets Gomer for a U-turn and is then detained in a citizen's arrest by Gomer for the same thing.
Opie and his chums take their roles as Robin Hood and his merry men seriously as they befriend a hobo at the expense of the pantries of Mayberry.
Barney organizes a rescue party when Andy and Helen are trapped in a cave by a landslide.

Aunt Bee stirs up a crusade for a chicken farmer whose property has been condemned to make way for a new road.
Barney adds a vintage motorcycle to the rolling stock of the Mayberry Sheriff's department, to the Sheriff's regret.
Ernest T. Bass is a would-be Romeo, who is brought into the sheriff's home in an effort to teach him some manners.
Mr. Drysdale is appalled to learn that Jed is going door-to-door peddling his services as a handyman. But then he's apoplectic when he discovers that Jed has been hired by a rival bank.
Jed gets an honorary doctorate when he donates money to the college that Mr. Drysdale attended. Now the family thinks he can now practice medicine, which doesn't sit well with Granny.

Mrs. Drysdale thinks she can get the hillbillies to move out by throwing herself at Jed. Meanwhile Granny is itching to fight her because she fell into the cement pond when Jed had to stop a fight between them earlier.
An old friend from back in the hills is now an Elvis like singing idol. The Clampetts misunderstand the situation and decide to help Johnny get on his feet.
Johnny Poke's mother arrives from the Ozarks and Granny's matchmaking begins. Jed and Emma Poke come up with a plan to discourage her.
Mrs. Drysdale needs Jed to donate $190,000 to save the Beverly Hills Ballet but he has his hands full trying to keep Granny from heading back to the hills pushing all her stuff in a wheelbarrow.
Mr. Drysdale talks the butler into staying on, posing as a boarder, so that he can teach the Clampetts how to be more civilized.
The Clampetts still don't realize that Mr. Pinckney is their butler instead of their boarder. When he tries to leave them Granny thinks he trying to skip without paying his rent.

Hospitalized for nerves from dealing with the hillbillies Mrs. Drysdale threatens Mr. Drysdale to stay there until he gets rid of them and even sending for a specialist. Unfortunately, the Clampet clan is on their way to visit her.
Mrs. Drysdale wakes up to find she is no longer in the hospital. The Clampetts, unhappy with what they feel as the hospital's poor level of care, break her out and set her up in their mansion.
Elly May goes to Jed's studio to be in a movie and meet a potential husband.
Ellie May loses another suitor to Miss Jane in another case of mistaken identity.
After the Clampetts accidentally run into a beatnik he moves into the Clampett mansion, but neither he nor they know what to make of each other.

As a favor to Jed Mr. Drysdale arranges for a playboy bank director (who normally only dates women half his age) to come court Granny, while Jed goes out with a beautiful woman who dates rich older men.

Granny wants Jed to find a wife and asks for Mr. Drysdale's help. He introduces Jed to Phyllis but learns too late she a gold digger and becomes alarmed when they head to the track. But it's Granny they need to worry about.

A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.
In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutal choosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.
Fingerprinting: The identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.
Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.
The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.
Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.
Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares and in the minds of serial killers.

A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path, challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.
Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

p.d: True-crime author, Carly, and her husband Kevin take a vacation at a historical mansion on Crawford Island. Kevin thinks it will be a chance for them to reconnect, but Carly plans to research an unsolved murder.
Birdie and Alden Case find a way to keep the mystery in their marriage alive, literally, when the amateur sleuths are pulled into a murder investigation.
High school senior, Nicolette, has bounced around from foster home to home. When she finds herself pregnant by the school quarterback, she quickly falls into despair…
A transfer student goes undercover as a cheerleader to expose the cruel cheerleader culture, only to find that her expose is linked to a series of attacks on cheerleaders by a mysterious assailant.
After her brother is killed in self-defense by his ex (Madison) whom he'd kidnapped, Lisa decides to take revenge on Madison by using a trauma support group to become her friend.
Miles apart, Molly and Lily become pen pals at 4th grade, continuing to write to each other throughout their lives. Things change however when Molly shows up at Lily's 25th Birthday...
Leading a double life as a fitness instructor and a prostitution ring with a client list, Sadie receives an anonymous tip and soon after her studio is raided by authorities.

En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.
Les tortues arrivent à s'introduire dans le vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Mais elles sont faites prisonnières et deviennent des gladiateurs dans l'arène Tricératon.
Sal et Mona tentent de s'allier avec Krang Second pour combattre les Tricératons. Krang Second les jette en prison. Les tortues sont à la recherche des autres fragments du générateur de trou noir.
Les tortues partent à la recherche du deuxième fragment que les Outromes ont confié aux Dagones Celles-ci vivent dans un royaume sous-marin, dans l'océan cosmique de Varuna.
Alors que les tortues s'apprêtent à partir chercher le dernier morceau du générateur de trou noir, elles sont happées dans un univers parallèle, celui des tortues ninja du dessin animé de 1987.
Les Tricératons ont suivi la trace du vaisseau Ulysse. Ils lancent un ultimatum à son équipage : soit ils leur remettent les fragments, soit ils se font anéantir.
Les tortues captent un signal de détresse. C'est Mona, qui leur apprend que son commandant Sal a été capturé par Armaggon sur l'ordre de Dregg.

Direction l'autre bout du cosmos, vers une galaxie au nom à rallonge, ZZ-Trois-Pluriel-X-Bêta, et plus particulièrement la planète Magdomar qui abrite selon les Outromes le troisième et dernier fragment du générateur de trou noir.

Le compte à rebours est lancé avant la mise en route du générateur de trou noir par les Tricératons pour aspirer la planète Terre. Il reste peu de temps aux tortues pour empêcher ces derniers de réduire la planète à néant.
Retour dans un New York tranquille. Cérémonie pour April, organisée par Splinter. Elle est désormais kunoïchi. Mais le soir même, une mystérieuse sorcière lui vole son tanto du dragon.

Leonardo a fait alliance en cachette avec Karaï et Shinigami pour démanteler une à une les opérations de Shredder. Ils commencent par une planque des Dragons Pourpres, puis s'attaquent à l'usine chimique, un lieu névralgique de l'organisation.

Stockman crée de nouveaux mutants pour l'aider à cambrioler les banques afin de réunir de l'argent pour Shredder. Un ancien homme d'affaires devient Scaramouche, un mutant mi-araignée mi-mouche. Il crée également une fourmi géante.

Worlds Collide - Part 3: At the secret Federation/military base, the turtles are about to be dissected by Agent Bishop, a very bad resident of planet earth. Luckily, our odd trio of commandos (Splinter, April and Casey) are moving in for the rescue.

Touch and Go: Welcome to the New World...same as the Old World. While the Turtles attempt to assess the damage around their lair, they find that adjusting to their post alien invasion lives might be harder than they thought.
Hunted: For a two ton reptile, Leatherhead actually makes the ideal houseguest; neat, tidy, always pays his rent on time … except for the fact that his temper is really out of control.
H.A.T.E.: Donatello, Michelangelo and Raphael come across a band of crazed, heavily armed, alien-hating Survivalists, bent upon delivering and detonating a thermo nuclear device in New York City.

Nobody's Fool: When Michelangelo and Leonardo are out getting a little night air, they cross paths with a caped crusader who ends up saving their lives. The Turtles soon learn that he's really a cop who is out to get the one man who ruined his career.
New Blood: The savior of New York City, Oroku Saki, has another face: the Shredder. The turtles stumble upon the Shredder's real reason for helping New York.

The Lesson: April asks the Turtles to help perfect her ninjitsu skills. But the Turtles are reluctant to do so and recount a story about how they once tried to take a student under their wing. They just weren't prepared to be teachers.

The Darkness Within: When Angel's brother disappears in the Wall Street area, the turtles jump to help her. Turns out that, as a result of all the destruction from the invasion, an ancient horror has been stirred.

Mission of Gravity: The Shredder sends Stockman and Hun on a quest to retrieve an Antigravity Generator from the city of Beijing, which is still floating in the upper atmosphere, thanks to the Triceratons.

The Entity Below: The Entity and his kind are awakened through a rare planetary alignment, and, harnessing great power, they proceed to start shifting the tectonic plates in order to bring back their world.
Time Travails: The turtles get sucked into a time traveling adventure by the somewhat vapid but totally cute Renet, Apprentice Timestress.

Hun on the Run: Hun's always been loyal, but too many failures have tarnished his relationship with his master. But, when Karai is captured by Bishop, the Shredder gives Hun a mission in which he can redeem himself: save Karai and bring her back alive.
Reality Check: Ultimate Drako is back and he's causing all sorts of chaos with the Time Scepter. He's sent the four turtles spinning through time into alternate realities.

Across The Universe: Because of Ultimate Drako's machinations, Raphael finds himself in an alternate reality … of the Planet Racers.This right down Raphael's alley … until that alley turns into a dead end and he's heading right for it!

Same as it Never Was: Ultimate Drako's time manipulations have sent Donatello to an alternate reality … and it's not pretty. It's one possible future, a horrible nightmare. The Shredder is all powerful.
